_provenance: Each expected range below was computed independently by hand from the raw disclosed figures in data/synthetic/founder_bios.md and data/synthetic/cap_table.md (exit value, founder equity % at exit, cap table %, latest implied valuation), applying the formula documented in CreditPulse_Sponsor_Diligence_PRD.md (prior-exit proceeds + current-stake value, +/-25% band around the point estimate) with a plain calculator/script — not by importing or running creditpulse.wealth_estimator. This exists to catch a real arithmetic bug in that module, not to restate its output.

Priya Anand.rationale: Lattice Metrics acquisition: $180.0M x 11.0% disclosed founder equity at exit = $19.8M. Meridian cap table stake: 18.0% x $220.0M latest implied valuation = $39.6M. Point estimate $59.4M; range is $59.4M x [0.75, 1.25] = [$44.55M, $74.25M], rounded to 1 decimal = [$44.6M, $74.2M]. Both components disclosed -> medium confidence.

Marcus Webb.rationale: Ferrotech Systems shut down with no proceeds to founders (disclosed fact, not an unknown) -> $0.0M prior-exit component, and this does not count as disclosed wealth data. Meridian cap table stake: 12.0% x $220.0M latest implied valuation = $26.4M. Point estimate $26.4M; range is $26.4M x [0.75, 1.25] = [$19.8M, $33.0M]. Only one real disclosed component (current stake) -> low confidence.

Dana Ilkay.rationale: No prior founder ventures disclosed at all (first executive-level equity position), and her Meridian equity grant is explicitly pending board ratification -- not part of the finalized fully-diluted cap table (cap_table.md Section 1). Zero real disclosed components -> the estimator must report insufficient_data explicitly, never a guessed range.
